links.outcome: LLM accuracy on gynecology MCQs from USMLE-style questions under zero-shot constrained prompts
links.effect: Overall accuracy unsatisfactory: Gemini-3 32.86%, DeepSeek-V3.2 30.00%, ChatGPT-5 25.71%, Claude-4.5-Opus 21.43%; ChatGPT-5 scored 0.00% in Infertility.
links.quote: Contrary to expectations for advanced models, overall accuracy was unsatisfactory: Gemini-3 (32.86%), DeepSeek-V3.2 (30.00%), ChatGPT-5 (25.71%), and Claude-4.5-Opus (21.43%).

links.outcome: Clinical knowledge errors and failure patterns in gynecological diagnosis
links.effect: Three failure patterns found: semantic association bias, spatial anatomy confusion, and genetic logic reversal; theoretically dangerous errors such as misdiagnosing adrenal enzymes.
links.quote: Qualitative analysis revealed three critical failure patterns: (1) semantic association bias (confusing high-probability diseases with symptom-specific diagnoses), (2) spatial anatomy confusion, and (3) genetic logic reversal.

unlisted_practices: Chain-of-thought prompting versus constrained non-reasoning prompting for gynecology accuracy

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on USMLE-derived gynecology multiple-choice questions without comparing specific deployment practices or safeguards.
